race.comment: Tricky race to assess with a stack of first-starters engaged. CAVALLUNA (14) is a Bivouac colt also on debut and shoulders a tidy price tag. Found the line stylishly here over the 1000m in his only trial. May need this hit-out but it'd be no shock to see him make a bright start. STAR ROUGE (8) looks an obvious danger, helped by Ben Thompson and a family that includes a Listed placegetter. Has come along nicely at the trials and can make a bright start. TINY LIGHT (9) is another interesting debutant. The Earthlight gelding hails from the sharp Tony Gollan camp and has impressed in his lead-up work. Drawn sticky but keeps Youngberry from the trials, who claims 3kg to get him in light. JOLAYNA DASH (18) looks best of the race bunch after making good late ground for fourth here last time. If she can settle closer this time with that run under her belt, she can play a major role.
